correctness.rationale: For every unfilled graph, all faces up to cardinality t+1 appear, and exactly the edge-containing (t+2)-sets are top faces. In the integral exterior chain model the boundary image equals the wedge ideal generated by graph edge differences. Their component-lattice quotient is primitive and free, yielding the claimed homology and naturality. For t>=2 Hurewicz and integral cell slides cancel all unit pairs, giving the actual wedge homotopy type. A standalone independent mod-two boundary-rank program passes 104416 finite graph/parameter instances; the infinite and integral steps are proved symbolically.
